method.description: HTTP method of the task's own request; defaults to GET. Ignored when template_id is set, because a bound task executes the template.

url.description: Request URL of a task that is not bound to a template. May be omitted when template_id is set: the task then mirrors the template's first request, because a task bound to a template always executes the template.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-request timeout in seconds (overrides the global request timeout)

retry_count.description: Retry count after a failed run: 0 = never, -1 = always, N = up to N retries

retry_interval_seconds.description: Delay before each retry, in seconds (default 60)

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used for cron scheduling (default UTC)

random_delay_max_seconds.description: Random delay before a due run executes, in seconds (0 = disabled); jitter is drawn uniformly from 0..=max at enqueue time

variables.description: Seed variables rendered into URLs, headers, bodies and template tasks

grp.description: Set to a string to change group, null to clear it, omit to leave unchanged

timeout_seconds.description: Set to a number to change, null to clear, omit to leave unchanged

random_delay_max_seconds.description: Set to a number to change, null to clear, omit to leave unchanged

log.description: QD-style log line: the final __log__ value extracted by the template execution

run_after.description: Earliest claim time for delayed (retry) runs; null means immediately claimable

retry_of.description: For retry runs: id of the first (original) run of the retry chain

UpdateNotificationAction.description: Partial update of one notification action; an absent field keeps its stored value.

grp.description: Set to a string to change group, null to clear it, omit to leave unchanged

variables.description: Input variables a task created from this template must supply (QD's 变量 list)

name.description: The entry's identity inside the source, and the local template name

comments.description: The manifest's variable documentation, reduced to plain text

source_id.description: Which source the entry came from; only the aggregate listing fills it in

source_name.description: Which source the entry came from; only the aggregate listing fills it in

source_kind.description: `manifest` when the source publishes tpls_history.json, `files` when the catalogue was derived by scanning the repository tree

names.description: Entry names to import, as returned by the library listing

entry.description: Entry identity inside the source, as returned by the listing

template_id.description: Local template to refresh in place; absent creates one

har.description: The HAR document as edited in the browser

entries.description: Entries from every source that could be read, in source order

sources.description: How each source contributed, including the ones that failed

truncated.description: True when the total entry cap was hit

source_kind.description: `manifest` or `files`; absent when the source could not be read

cached.description: True when the catalogue was reused instead of fetched again

LibraryImportOutcome.description: One entry that landed in the store during an import, so the caller can act on what it just pulled in (open the editor prefilled, build a task) instead of only reading counters.

updated.description: `true` when an existing template was refreshed in place rather than created

templates.description: Every entry this call wrote, in the order it was requested
